historical_references.reference: According to Hindu mythology, Mandar is the name of the mountain where the God Shiva performed the Tandava dance. The dance is said to have lasted for millions of years, and Mandar Mountain is where Shiva's footprints are believed to be found.

In another reference, Mandar is mentioned in the Mahabharata as the name of a demon, son of Viprachitti. He is said to have angered Lord Indra by refusing to pay obeisance to him, and was subsequently killed by Indra and his allies.
